newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -BTPs to hold gains, trendline underpins.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -BTPs to hold gains, trendline underpins.

text.p: June BTP futures on LIFFE should quietly stay in positive territory on Tuesday after it resurfaced above a trendline from lows on Monday, technical analysts said.
The contract jumped back to close at 129.18 on Monday after dipping to a session low of 128.23. By 0720 GMT on Tuesday the June BTP was nine basis points higher on the day at 129.27.
Regina Neder, technical analyst at DMG Futures & Options in Frankfurt, said the June contract was now strongly underpinned by the up trendline drawn from April 1 that comes in at 128.87.
"As long as we keep above that trendline I think you can stay on the long side," Neder said.
Neder forecast a trading range between 129.00 and 129.30 for Tuesday. If 129.30 was taken out the next resistance would be 129.46/50, the down trendline from the peak on May 21, she said.
Beyond 129.50, Neder saw little resistance until 129.75.
An analyst at a German bank in London said BTPs would likely run out of steam and suffer minor losses in the near term but would push back up again to test major resistance.

June BTPs would first test a downtrend near 129.43 coming from the daily chart. If this broke further retracement was likely, the analyst said. "I expect for the very short term that we'll see a retracement to 129.19/20."

But the contract could then resume an upward retracement phase with an initial test of 129.46, a 62 percent retracement of the move from 130.32 on May 28 to the low of 128.06 on May 30, the analyst said.
"We have strong resistance in this area."
A break of 129.46 would, however, lead to further gains to 129.73/129.79, a strong retracement area of the drop between May 28 and May 30, and possibly to 130.32, she said.
By 0810 GMT, the June Eurolira future was up three basis points on the day at 93.17.
